tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
7/9

The price will decide between 72k and 77k. Five lines sit in that band:

→ 20-week average: 72.4k
→ 200-day average: 73.2k
→ Cost of coins bought in the last 5 months: 75.8k
→ 50-week average: 76.0k
→ 21-week EMA: 76.5k

Bitcoin trades less than 1 % above it.

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
6/9

"So June was the low?"

Not proven. Each of these arguments compares this cycle with two or three earlier ones.

And the clock disagrees: in 2018 and 2022, bitcoin needed 12 months from its high to its low. Counted from October, June came after 9.

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
5/9

ETF holders have not sold the pullback either.

Bitcoin is 11 % below its October 4 close of 86.5k. US spot ETFs took in a net $29m over the 30 days to October 28.

That is no buying wave. It is not an exit either.

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
4/9

The second argument is Asia.

Korea's KOSPI and China's CSI 300 peaked on June 22, at the height of the AI trade. Since then:

→ KOSPI: −37 %
→ CSI 300: −20 %
→ Bitcoin: +20 %

Bitcoin bottomed eight days after Asia topped and has held up through the AI sell-off.

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
3/9

Measured in gold, June was no new low at all.

Ounces of gold per bitcoin, monthly close:

→ Jan 2025 peak: 36.5
→ Feb 2026 low: 12.5
→ Jun 2026: 14.6
→ Now: 19.8

In dollars, June undercut February. In gold, bitcoin has gained 59 % since February.

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
2/9

The case for June starts at the top.

Bitcoin peaked twice: 123.4k in August 2025, 124.8k in October, 1 % apart, without a final spike.

From there to June it fell 53 %. The 2021/22 bear market fell 77 %, close to close.

This bear market is 24 points shallower so far.
